|ingredients = {{Name|Omelet|1}}{{Name|Parsnip|1}} }} '''Farmer's Lunch''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Farmer's Lunch may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on Saturdays. Five Farmer's Lunches may occasionally be found in a [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure room]] in the Skull Cavern. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy |hate=Sebastian |love=Marnie |dislike=Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Farmer's Lunch is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]]. ==Recipes== Farmer's Lunch is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== Farmer's Lunch is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt068.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== Farmer's Lunch is not used in any [[Quests|quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.5|Can now be prepared using a [[Cookout Kit]].}} {{History|1.6|[[Harvey]]'s Saturday Fall dialogue changed from "Farmer's Brunch" to "Farmer's Lunch".}} {{NavboxRecipes}} [[Category:Recipes]] [[Category:Cooking]] [[de:Bauernmahlzeit]] [[es:Almuerzo de granjero]] [[fr:Déjeuner du fermier]] [[it:Pranzo del fattore]] [[ja:牧場主のランチ]] [[ko:농부의 점심]] [[hu:Gazdák ebédje]] [[pt:Almoço de fazendeiro]] [[ru:«Обед фермера»]] [[tr:Çiftçi Öğünü]] [[zh:农夫午餐]]
